name: Steakhouse Prime USDC
oneLiner: steakUSDC is Steakhouse's Morpho Vault V2 over USDC; withdrawals use idle USDC and a configured liquidity adapter, while strategy losses can reduce share price.
collateral: USDC deposited into a Steakhouse-curated Morpho Vault V2 that aims to lend against blue-chip crypto and real-world asset collateral markets depending on market conditions
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 Morpho Vault V2 shares accrue strategy interest and realize losses against USDC; withdrawals use idle assets and the configured liquidity adapter, subject to available market liquidity

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact deployment is an immutable Morpho Vault V2 ERC-4626 share over USDC. User shares mint against deposits; interest accrual can also mint management and performance fee shares. The vault does not create discretionary USDC supply.
